author: Dominic-Stafford
body:
#### PR description:

This is an updated version of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51940, which ensures when using the FxFx handler for madgraph matching the appropriate flags are set on the relevant FxFxShowerHandler, not on the default ShowerHandler, which is not used. As part of this a new version of the herwig7CH3PDF settings, which also changes the shower parameters, is added, and all PDF settings are moved to this block (some, but not all were previously in hw_mg_merging_settings). This new herwig7_mg_merging_CH3PDF settings should be used in place of herwig7CH3PDF for all FxFx and MLM requests, and must be loaded after the hw_mg_merging_settings- I'll ask for this to be added to the GEN checking script once this is merged and backported.

[Link to original CMS talk discussion.](https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/possible-issue-observed-with-madgraph-herwig-z-jets-sample-in-run-2-legacy-simulation/147280/9)

#### PR validation:

Tested with worflows 537 and 538 (Herwig DY FxFx and MLM matching)

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Will need backporting to 10_6 for run 2 UL, and all run 3 gen releases
title: Fix incorrect references to ShowerHandler in Herwig7MGMergingSetting
